source_case: RESECT Case4 unchanged T1-derived estimated envelope, not accepted retained-tissue truth
required_order: Bind exact committed source, native images, unchanged mask/surface, source-only partition and fixed baseline alignment receipt before further data access.
Independent qualified reviewer accepts local T1-to-FLAIR and MRI-to-before-US anatomy/frame correspondence and unchanged retained-tissue approximation; current acceptance is false.
Only after both decisions, separately release source-only reference coordinates and bounded support check. B/V destination triplets and during-US remain inaccessible.

frame.native_coordinate_unit: RAS millimetres from original NIfTI sforms
frame.proposed_T1_to_FLAIR: physical RAS identity hypothesis, not verified for exact delivered patient files
frame.proposed_T1_to_before_US: fixed FLAIR-to-before-US proper-rigid transform times independently accepted T1-to-FLAIR transform
frame.source_coordinate_transfer: invert the accepted T1-to-before-US physical map for each before-US reference/source point

geometric_rule.voxel_domain: unchanged binary T1 mask as full affine-transformed half-cell union
geometric_rule.full_cell_bounds: separately require source inside native T1 full-cell bounds
geometric_rule.signed_distance: exact distance to exposed voxel faces in RAS mm; positive inside, negative outside, boundary within 1e-6 mm HOLD
geometric_rule.kernel: w(r)=max(0,1-r/5 mm) with physical radius held fixed
geometric_rule.integrated_units: unweighted volume mm3, weighted mass mm3, weighted first moment mm4, centroid offset mm
geometric_rule.primary_quadrature: native voxel-cell midpoint orders 4 and 8 per axis
geometric_rule.independent_quadrature: native voxel-cell Gauss-Legendre order 8 per axis
geometric_rule.minimum_weighted_support_fraction_meanin: Frozen numerical observation-operator support floor from mechanics-patient-observation; not a clinical tissue-volume threshold
geometric_rule.connectivity: six-neighbour connected support occupied by positive quadrature mass; independent surface/mask classification required
geometric_rule.B_gate: all six centres strictly inside; converged weighted mass at least 1e-4 of full tent; one connected containing support component; mask/surface agreement; rigid-mode averaged operator rank six
geometric_rule.V_rule: count all 13 fixed V source rows, including unsupported, outside, ambiguous and nonconverged; any unsupported row makes original all-13 RMS not estimable

review_and_execution.output_handling: restricted ignored directory 0700/files 0600; row coordinates and patient pixels excluded from Git; review_pending until independent engineering and anatomy audit

interpretation_limit: Geometric source support alone does not validate displacement prediction, tool contact, force, cutting, injury, retraction, clinical outcomes or generalization.
